faqs.hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.hero.subtitle: Your Questions Answered
faqs.q1.question: 📍 Where is Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram located?
faqs.q1.answer: The ashram is located in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, just 500 meters from Shri Ram Mandir. Address: Bada Bhakt Maal, near Jain Mandir, Ramghat, New Colony, Ayodhya, UP - 224123
faqs.q2.question: 🕉️ What are the Aarti timings?
faqs.q3.question: 🏠 Is accommodation available at the ashram?
faqs.q3.answer: Yes, the ashram provides accommodation facilities for devotees. Please visit our
faqs.q3.details: for more details and booking information.
faqs.q4.question: 🍲 Is food provided at the ashram?
faqs.q4.answer: Yes, the ashram provides free Annadan Seva (free meals) for devotees and visitors. Simple vegetarian sattvic food is served with love and devotion.
faqs.q5.question: 💰 Can I make donations to the ashram?
faqs.q5.answer: Yes, donations are welcome and help support our various seva activities including Annadan, Gau Seva, Gurukul, and maintenance of the ashram. Please contact us for donation details.
faqs.q6.question: 🚗 How do I reach the ashram?
faqs.q6.answer: The ashram is well-connected by road, rail, and air. The nearest railway station is Ayodhya Junction, and the nearest airport is Ayodhya Airport. For detailed directions, visit our
faqs.q7.question: 📿 Are there regular Satsang and Katha programs?
faqs.q7.answer: Yes, the ashram regularly organizes Satsang, Shri Ram Katha, and spiritual discourses. Visit our
faqs.q7.details: for current schedules and upcoming events.
faqs.q8.question: 👔 Is there a dress code?
faqs.q8.answer: We request devotees to dress modestly. Avoid shorts, sleeveless tops, and revealing clothing. Traditional Indian attire is appreciated but not mandatory.
faqs.q9.question: 📸 Can I take photographs inside the ashram?
faqs.q9.answer: Photography is allowed in designated areas. Please be respectful and ask permission before photographing deities, rituals, or people. Video recording may have restrictions.
faqs.q10.question: 💍 Can we organize Vivah Sanskara at the ashram?
faqs.q10.answer: Yes, the ashram facilitates Vivah Sanskara (traditional Hindu wedding ceremonies) according to Vedic traditions. Please visit our

faqs.cta.title: Still Have Questions?
faqs.cta.desc: Feel free to contact us directly. Our team is here to help you with any queries.
